README.md
+## Features
+- Start with four sample tasks, add tasks with sequential IDs and an `open`
+  status, and use checkboxes to switch tasks between `open` and `done`.
+  Completed task titles are crossed out.
+- Switch the interface between English and Spanish. The language selector
+  translates the page title, heading, form labels, and accessible labels.
+  It remembers the choice in local storage when available; task titles stay
+  as entered.
+- Follow the system's light or dark color preference automatically.
+- Filter tasks through `filterTasks(tasks, query, status)` in
+  [`src/model.mjs`](src/model.mjs). Search matches title substrings without
+  regard to case and trims surrounding query whitespace. Status accepts
+  `all` (the default), `open`, or `done`; search and status conditions must
+  both match. Results preserve task order without changing the input list.
+### Current limitations
+  and completion changes are not saved.
+- Filtering is available in the model only. The page has no search or status
+  controls, and `src/components/filter-bar.js` is a placeholder.
+- `src/theme.js` provides `initTheme()` and a stored system/light/dark toggle,
+  but the page does not call the initializer or include a `theme-toggle`
+  button. Only automatic system theming is active in the page.
+- Task titles are accepted as entered, including empty or whitespace-only
+  titles. Title validation is not implemented.
+## Run locally
+Serve the repository root through a static HTTP server and open `index.html`
+in a browser. For example, with Python installed, run:
+python -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1
+Then open <http://127.0.0.1:8000/>. Use HTTP rather than opening the file
+directly so JavaScript modules and the Spanish JSON catalog can load.
+No dependency installation or build step is required.
+## Run tests
+Install Node.js with npm and support for the built-in Node test runner, then
+run this command from the repository root:
+npm test
+The package script runs `node --test`; it does not need a running web server
+or any third-party packages. Tests in [`test/model.test.mjs`](test/model.test.mjs)
+cover task IDs and initial status, completion toggling, case-insensitive
+search, query whitespace, status filtering, combined filters, empty results,
+and preservation of input data and task order.
+[`test/validation.test.mjs`](test/validation.test.mjs) is currently a placeholder
+with no assertions. Node counts that file as a passing test, which does not
+establish title-validation coverage. The suite does not exercise the browser
+UI, language switching, or theme behavior. Local test results are separate
+from Pytxo's recorded verification for the task.

# Task board

A small task board used by the Pytxo fleet demo.

## Features

- Start with four sample tasks, add tasks with sequential IDs and an `open`
  status, and use checkboxes to switch tasks between `open` and `done`.
  Completed task titles are crossed out.
- Switch the interface between English and Spanish. The language selector
  translates the page title, heading, form labels, and accessible labels.
  It remembers the choice in local storage when available; task titles stay
  as entered.
- Follow the system's light or dark color preference automatically.
- Filter tasks through `filterTasks(tasks, query, status)` in
  [`src/model.mjs`](src/model.mjs). Search matches title substrings without
  regard to case and trims surrounding query whitespace. Status accepts
  `all` (the default), `open`, or `done`; search and status conditions must
  both match. Results preserve task order without changing the input list.

### Current limitations

- Tasks live in memory. Reloading restores the sample tasks, so additions
  and completion changes are not saved.
- Filtering is available in the model only. The page has no search or status
  controls, and `src/components/filter-bar.js` is a placeholder.
- `src/theme.js` provides `initTheme()` and a stored system/light/dark toggle,
  but the page does not call the initializer or include a `theme-toggle`
  button. Only automatic system theming is active in the page.
- Task titles are accepted as entered, including empty or whitespace-only
  titles. Title validation is not implemented.

## Run locally

Serve the repository root through a static HTTP server and open `index.html`
in a browser. For example, with Python installed, run:

```sh
python -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Then open <http://127.0.0.1:8000/>. Use HTTP rather than opening the file
directly so JavaScript modules and the Spanish JSON catalog can load.
No dependency installation or build step is required.

## Run tests

Install Node.js with npm and support for the built-in Node test runner, then
run this command from the repository root:

```sh
npm test
```

The package script runs `node --test`; it does not need a running web server
or any third-party packages. Tests in [`test/model.test.mjs`](test/model.test.mjs)
cover task IDs and initial status, completion toggling, case-insensitive
search, query whitespace, status filtering, combined filters, empty results,
and preservation of input data and task order.

[`test/validation.test.mjs`](test/validation.test.mjs) is currently a placeholder
with no assertions. Node counts that file as a passing test, which does not
establish title-validation coverage. The suite does not exercise the browser
UI, language switching, or theme behavior. Local test results are separate
from Pytxo's recorded verification for the task.
